title: lammpsrun minor fixes/improvements
body:
Just a two minor fixes/improvement I noticed when using the lammpsrun module:
- support setting initial velocities
- don't hardcode fix nve (unless no fix is specified)

For the second one, I'm honestly not sure about the original intention, but setting it silently feels wrong as it will interfere with whatever fix the user sets.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you so much @ondracka for the MR! Sorry for the late response.

Both the changes look quite reasonable to me:

- With [the `velocity` command](https://docs.lammps.org/velocity.html), we get the flexibility to let LAMMPS decide the initial velocities.
- I also fully agree with you about the hard-coded `fix nve`. It exists since the very beginning of the `LAMMPS` calculator (7cc6e76f0a7e6447fe7ecbfbe335d769e6c64442), while the user-specified `fix` was implemented in !481. It may however make less sense to set `fix nve` always beforehand the user-specified `fix`, so it may be OK to say this is a bug to be fixed.

I have added a test for `velocity` on my side.
[I also checked in my forked repo that the revised MR passes the tests.](https://gitlab.com/yuzie007/ase/-/pipelines/2228972648)
I believe there would be no strong oppositions, so I would like to merge soon.
